diagrams.title: Skin layers with a hive and angioedema (schematic cross-section)

labels.name: Epidermis
labels.function: Outer layer; stays smooth without scale over a hive

labels.name: Dermis
labels.function: Middle layer housing mast cells, vessels and itch endings

labels.name: Subcutaneous tissue
labels.function: Fatty layer beneath the middle layer of skin

labels.name: Wheal edema
labels.function: Superficial fluid making a transient raised itchy plaque

labels.name: Angioedema
labels.function: Deep fluid causing asymmetrical swelling of lip or eyelid

labels.name: Mast cell
labels.function: Degranulates when IgE-activated, releasing histamine

labels.name: Dermal blood vessel
labels.function: Dilates and leaks under histamine, giving redness and edema

labels.name: Free nerve ending
labels.function: Receptor site where histamine and IL-31 trigger itch

labels.name: Free nerve ending
labels.function: Binds histamine, IL-31 and neurotransmitters in the skin

labels.name: Unmyelinated C fiber
labels.function: Carries itch along with pain and temperature

labels.name: Dorsal root ganglion
labels.function: Holds the afferent cell bodies before entry to the cord

labels.name: Spinal cord
labels.function: Where the signal crosses to the opposite side

labels.name: Spinothalamic tract
labels.function: Ascends on the side opposite the itchy skin

labels.name: Thalamus
labels.function: Relays the ascending signal up to the cortex

labels.name: Somatosensory cortex
labels.function: Processes itch, producing the urge to scratch

labels.name: Allergen
labels.function: Cross-links bound antibodies, e.g., shellfish, drug or latex

labels.name: IgE antibody
labels.function: Neutralized by omalizumab; drives type I hypersensitivity

labels.name: IgE receptor
labels.function: Targeted by autoantibodies in autoimmune chronic hives

labels.name: Mast cell
labels.function: Degranulates, releasing tryptase, heparin and other mediators

labels.name: Granule
labels.function: Stores preformed mediators until degranulation

labels.name: Histamine
labels.function: Causes vasodilation, vascular leak and itch

labels.name: H1 receptor
labels.function: Site blocked by cetirizine and loratadine
